When Hinata's best friend, Makoto—with whom he's been in unrequited love for years—moves in with his girlfriend, Hinata is heartbroken... That is, until Makoto's younger brother, Toki—who may or may not be harboring some unrequited feelings of his own—suddenly decides to move in with Hinata!

Toki is like a little brother to Hinata! So when Toki rolls over in his sleep and starts kissing him, Hinata assumes it's just a fluke. Toki must have been dreaming about somebody else, right? It's not like Toki is totally in love with Hinata and desperately jealous of his feelings for Makoto... right? And what if it is...? Are Hinata's growing feelings for Toki just a bandaid for his broken heart? A replacement for Makoto? Or could there be real feelings and a real future between Hinata and his best friend's brother?

162021.description: This is a fictional re-telling of the life of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, with a new twist. Mozart was actually born a girl, but her father chose to pass her off as a boy when he witnessed her early genius in music. The main story begins when Mozart is 25, working successfully as a musician in Vienna. "He" is wildly popular, especially with the ladies, but "he" mostly avoids them in order to protect the secret of "his" gender. Unfortunately, another local composer, Antonio Salieri, suspects that Mozart is actually a woman. When Mozart begins courting a girl, Constanze Weber, it seems impossible that "his" secret and career will endure!

162082.description:
Soojung and Daehoon have the seemingly perfect marriage. It’s been nine years, but their sex life is better than ever. The two decide they want to have a baby, but no matter how hard they try, Soojung cannot seem to get pregnant. One day, Soojung forgets a towel in the shower and tries to sneak to her bedroom, only to literally run into her father-in-law, Mr. Seo! Flustered by the very naked and extremely attractive Soojung, Mr. Seo runs away immediately. At first Soojung is embarrassed about the encounter, but then she gets to thinking… her father-in-law is handsome, smart, and a prolific educator…she’s always wanted a child like him! Not to mention, he even has the same blood type as Daehoon. She’s not having any success with her husband, so why not go for the next best thing…?

Jiro Ayasegawa has a natural gift for sports, but life can be lonely at the top. He’s crushed other players’ dreams. Some have even given up their sport altogether because of him. Eventually, he encounters "The Bambies," a low-level, local kids’ baseball team that plays purely for fun. Jiro signs up, thinking that he’s finally found an easy-going team to enjoy baseball with, until things take a sudden turn...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

162085.description:
Unpei Mochizuki had been working for two years as a spare parts dealer. After making a mistake, he had only one wish: to go far, where no one can recognize him. That’s when he crosses paths with Tsugumi Nagisa, illustrator… and nomad. A woman of indefinable age, who lives with her dog in a van. Unpei begins a new life on the road with Tsugumi and her car. Far from the usual tidy, sedentary lifestyle, the nomadic spirit offers new surprises every single day. From beaches to mountains, from the North to the South… Freedom and endless new landscapes await!

(Source: Noeve grafx, translated)

Note: Originally halted after 18 chapters in 3 volumes on 2021-08-24. Serialization was resumed on 2024-07-10.

162088.description:
Is he an eccentric or a sage? Does the seemingly unremarkable salaryman, Fujii, redefine the definition of "happiness?"

In the workplace, he's a plain middle-aged man who doesn't stand out. While he does his job competently, he's not one to waste words. Come quitting time, he disappears like a ghost. He's not the type to be invited to after-work drinks in the first place. More like, he's the guy who's thought of as "I wouldn't want to end up like that..." by his juniors.

Yet, he piques the curiosity of others...
"I wonder how he was raised?"
"Does he have friends or a girlfriend?"
"What does he do on weekends?"

Suddenly, you realize you've become captivated by Fujii... An elusive emotion that's hard to put into words is vividly captured by the author of Reborn no Kishi in this bewitching life drama!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

When she shows up in front of him, wearing a cutesy, feminine outfit, will she get the hopeless late bloomer’s heart racing? When you can’t put your feelings into words, an image change might just be the right gambit!

With all the money he could ever need already tucked away, he considers retiring. But he's instead suddenly called on to investigate the New World!

En route to his new destination, he comes across and tames a slightly offbeat juvenile dragon.

Not without getting something in return, that is. Revenge is a dish best served cold but Bitna is here to make it steaming hot and dressed in frills and laces! She joins ranks with Seo Jihun, the owner of Ehwa’s rival company, to take Ehwa down. But revenge isn’t the only thing in the works it seems… Bitna and Jihun are falling for each other. However, he summarily rejects her offer, dismissing it as unrealistic "youthful enthusiasm." Sakura, however, is not ready to give up, and offers him a “contract” to join the club. Art university student Nagi Kitagawa is hopelessly in love with Yuu Yamasaki, his senpai in the folk song club who also happens to be his next door neighbor. Yuu seems to have it all—good looks, a great personality, and he's also super popular—so Nagi can't help but think he'd never fall for a shy, innocent country bumpkin like him. One night, after drinking too much at one of their club get-togethers, Nagi helps a drunk Yuu get home safe—but before he can go back to his own apartment, Yuu wraps Nagi in his arms and falls asleep, trapping Nagi in his embrace. Nagi sneaks out the next morning, careful to not wake Yuu up, and vows to keep the incident a secret. But when Nagi finds himself growing closer and closer to Yuu, his unrequited feelings only grow stronger… And could it be that his love isn't as one-sided as he thinks it is…?

Aoba is baffled by the apartment, as it is different from what he'd been told, but the landlord, Mikuru, who has a short hairline and bottle-bottomed glasses, desperately tries to convince Aoba to stay. Aoba eventually decides to stay because of the beautiful view of the ocean from his room, but when he goes to tell him about his decision, he is shocked by the adorable sight of Mikuru, who takes off his glasses and weeps with relief. Aoba finds himself charmed by Mikuru's dedication in running the apartment, and Mikuru begins to contemplate a way he can be useful to Aoba.

When his coworker comes to him one day with the idea of advertising their real estate agency as LGBT-friendly, Toshi realizes this little change could really help people who often face discrimination in his industry. He's terrified, though, because he worries this move will out him as gay. Joined by his boyfriend Gonta who inspired him to bake in the first place, Toshi navigates a changing world that's slowly becoming more accepting, faces his fears and discomfort, and bakes some incredibly lovely treats along the way.

Riley has always known his feelings for his step-uncle Blake are unusual. Enchanted by Blake's charms, Riley's infatuation shatters and melds with overwhelming guilt when his parents cold-bloodedly scrape every penny from Blake, leaving him wounded and broken. The pain of betrayal distances them for years until Riley joins Blake's talent agency, swearing to make it big in showbiz to repay everything his family owes.

(Source: Webcomics)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

162179.description:
Qin Jun was just an overworked corporate slave, until he transmigrated into the body of a deposed prince. But at least he was blessed with the Legend Summoning System. He can summon any character from legend to command! See the mighty Wukong shake the mountain with one strike of his staff, while seeing and hearing all with his powers! The Buddha himself can hold the world in the palm of his hand, and no one can escape! In this fantastical world of gods and demons, see how Qin Jun becomes the most powerful emperor of all!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

162180.description:
Yasutaka Iijima, a boy wearing glasses, sits in the corner of the classroom and wants nothing to do with Ema Kitaoka, a popular gal in the same class. However, after a chance meeting at the school camping trip, they started talking with each other, but only outside of school. They are both unsure of each other's "true feelings."

(Source: Comic Howl, translated)
synonyms: I was supposed to never fall in love with you

162181.description:
It doesn't matter if we can't even become mates! What is the fate of an omega who loves a beta?

Kouichi was born to a family with alpha lineage and is pressured every day by his father to mate with a capable alpha to produce an heir. Kouichi's rock is his childhood friend, a beta named Hiromu. He's always liked him since they were kids, but when considering his family and the fact that he's an omega, he hasn't told Hiromu his feelings.

Meanwhile, when his heat starts, Kouichi masturbates to fantasies of doing it with Hiromu. Disgusted by himself, he takes out his anger on Hiromu, who worries about him. In desperation, he decides that he should just mate with a random alpha and decides to be held by a man who comes near him!? On the other hand, Kouichi's father arbitrarily decides to go forward with betrothing him to an alpha...

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

162182.description:
He's straight, a prostitute, and 12 years younger than me. I never should have gotten involved... now that I'm stuck with him, there's no going back. One night, Akihito visits his usual gay bar where, on a whim, helps a young man, Seia, getting harassed by a customer. By doing so, Seia offers Akihito..."want to have a good time with me tonight?" Akihito takes him to a VIP room with devilish intentions to tease him, but upon seeing his innocent reactions, a rush of warmth spread throughout his entire body...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Naughty Boy's Way of Love

162183.description:
Ookami is at the end of his rope trying to find a suitable secretary. In his desperation, he decides to launch the “Rent A Boyfriend” app to enlist the help of Mao, a rental boyfriend. When they meet in person, Ookami realizes that Mao is even more gorgeous than his photos, and finds himself bewitched by the handsome man. Before he can even make sense of what’s happening, Mao’s tongue is in his mouth as they share a passionate kiss. Ookami’s protestations only spur Mao on: “What’s with that scary face? You’re just turning me on even more.” As things escalate, Ookami chides him: “You have no regard for others.” But Mao takes no heed, continuing to work Ookami up into a frenzy…

Check out this new, erotic love story between a mistrustful boss and his aggressive boy toy!

(Source: INKR)

162184.description:
Minato is a college student with no future and no ambition. He spends his days goofing off, and his nights sleeping around. One day, he meets a famous prodigy artist named Riku, who attends the same college despite it not being an art school. Minato's first impression of Riku is that he's a weirdo, but when Minato has no place to stay one night, Riku lets him crash. After Minato sees him paint, urges start welling up inside him. Is he of all people falling in love...?

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

162185.description:
"Maybe I'll have you fall into me, Suzume."

Suzume, a clerk at a cafe, receives a business card from one of his regulars, a handsome businessman by the name of Miyaji. Not only that, but Suzume's coworker tells him he thinks Miyaji has a thing for him! Not willing to just take being made fun of by a hot guy like that, Suzume decides to fight back...!! The next day, Suzume gets touchy-feely with Miyaji, but that doesn't change Miyaji's mature demeanor... or so he thought. At night, when it's just the two of them at the cafe, a sudden passionate gaze and an intense kiss make Suzume's hips ache sweetly...

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

Ever since novelist Qiao Xiaoqi changed the ending to her novel, she was cursed to isekai into her own story as the female lead who gets killed by the male lead! When the personality of the male lead, Jun Mojue, grows more and more twisted due to constant persecution, Qiao Xiaoqi tries to stop him from going down this dark path. At first, she just wanted to decrease his darkness percentage so she could go home, but soon she started to have real feelings…

162187.description:
"Hey. Marry me."
"...Huh!!?"

Famous T.V. star Ren is in the worst trouble he's ever been in after press catch on to a love scandal between him and a male idol. When his family calls an emergency meeting to try and fix things, his childhood family friend and popular actor Mitsuru suddenly proposes to him!?

It was supposed to be a non-romantic, "fake marriage" type arrangement that let Mitsuru concentrate on his work, but Ren starts finding this honeymoon life surprisingly enjoyable. The only thing he's worried about is how to deal with his sexual appetite...? When he lets that issue slip by mistake, Mitsuru says "why don't we have our first night together?" and his body starts throbbing and heating up...!?

The newlywed love comedy between an obsessive actor and a moronic celebrity who's weak to pleasure!

162190.description:
Renoc was supposed to be a video game character, so giving him a dying body in exchange for extreme magical prowess felt reasonable. However, when his creator wakes up inside Renoc's body, it doesn't feel like a game anymore! His life in the game is unbearable until he discovers the mysterious drug Vyper, which gives him the strength to wield his magic to its full potential. As Renoc walks a fine line with the drug that could save or destroy him, can he find a way to survive in this new world?

162191.description:
After waking up in the hospital, Shin Cheon-gi discovers that he’s lost all his memories. He can’t recall his family, his job, or even his name. But what he does remember is a steamy hot night he spent with a woman who had a heart-shaped mark in a rather…private area of her body. Cheon-gi has a feeling that this mysterious woman holds the answers to his missing memories, and he’s determined to find her - no matter how many women he has to sleep with!

There are four Magic Divisions in the military giant that is the Kingdom of Hiraith. The First Magic Division is the elite of the royal guard, the Second Magic Division is the field combat unit, the Third Magic Division is the research and development organization for magic and magical tools, and the Fourth Magic Division consists of those who have other unique skillsets.

Among them, Levi was the most unusual, being a sorcerer incapable of using magic and having nothing he wanted to accomplish. In the midst of his days of mere subsistence and despair, Levi meets Prince Saphir, the 13th prince, who is known as the Moribund Prince. Levi, 16 years old, and 6-year-old Saphir...it was a fateful encounter! In a royal palace full of malice, the two of them discover human warmth for the first time...

With the return of spirit energy, every living thing started to mutate, and his life was soon turned into a game of survival. Luckily, he was gifted with the ability of infinite evolution. One day, the time machine built by Takeru is activated for the first time in 15 years, and Tama-hime, the younger sister of Hisanaga, is brought back from the Edo period. Tama-hime tells Tsuki that she had to give up on the man she loves and will soon be married into the family of a feudal lord. Tsuki, who is an inventor prone to doing "outrageous things" just like her father, decides makes a big move...

To pay off the debt of her once-wealthy family, the beautiful Leyfa is sold off as "a rare item that will bring prosperity" and taken to a distant empire. I want to be loved, as a person, and as a woman. - Misaki Nakamichi (35) is a teacher who has been married for 5 years to her attractive husband. She appears to have a life that many would be envious of. However, the truth is that she has been concerned about her marriage due to the lack of intimacy - Her husband only sleeps with her once a year, on the day of their wedding anniversary. Mikako, 72, has just lost her husband. From now on, she plans to live alone, sticking with the house where she lived with her husband. When her worried children and grandchildren give her a smartphone, she accidentally connects it to her dead husband's account... If you read this, old age won't seem so bad. The art of living alone near age 100 (lifehack)!

If you work hard, even if it's difficult, you can be happy... isn't that how the world was supposed to be! On her wedding day, Kyoko's fiancee runs away and leaves her at the altar. Now she's stuck with the cancellation fees for the ceremony, while working at uncomfortable workplace, unable to find a new job and pay for a move... The world is hard for 25-year old graduates... Then Kyoko has more misfortunes and a fateful encounter! Life is not something to be trifled with, and the one who enjoys the journey the most wins! The two become fast friends... and Akira soon discovers different sides to Eishi that he usually hides from others, which are too cute for words... 162251.description: The book looks back at one of the darkest pages in Korean history: the 1948 massacre of tens of thousands of Jeju Islanders, marking the establishment of the authoritarian regime of Syngman Rhee, supported by the American occupation forces. Jiseul is based on the true story of 120 villagers, islanders, who hid in the caves of Seogwipo, after the American occupation authorities designated all residents within a 5 km radius from the coast as "rioters" and ordered them to be executed. The word "Jiseul" in Jeju dialect means potato and is the symbol of the islanders' hope for survival.

162252.description:

And in the grand tradition of reluctant pet owners, she and their puppy soon become inseparable. The young couple even goes so far as to relocate from Seoul to soothe their new canine pal’s anxiety. After all, there’s nothing like a move to the country to set yourself right. Right?

The idyll of a quiet life soon gives way to a surprising degree of antagonism, including clashes with long-time local residents of a different generation. The culture shock is palpable for all three urban transplants as the isolation of their new environs starts to sink in. They eventually adopt another dog, and still another–all while reckoning with the ups and downs of middle-age and childlessness in an unforgivingly traditional milieu.

(Source: Drawn & Quarterly)

162253.description:
The turn of the 20th century. From the Korean village in Siberia where she was born, to Khabarovsk where she founded the Far Eastern People's Committee for Lenin, Alexandra Kim (1885-1918) dedicated her dazzling life to the defense of workers' rights.

At the risk of her life, this Korean Bolshevik revolutionary became the sounding board for the anger of Russian, Korean and Chinese proletarians, constantly endangered by their working conditions. A convinced political activist, she accomplished each of her actions with a soul and a will that no force could hinder.

Blending into the panorama of a tumultuous time, a porous region, and a merciless society, the unknown destiny of this woman was to live her life according to a horizon where freedom, like the landscape, would be offered to all.

Mamiya doesn't know how it feels to love someone, but he learns of Kosaka's devotion to selling his body, and decides to buy all his time so that he doesn't have to take other customers. The problem is, Amelie can’t help staring wistfully whenever she sees a certain third-year delinquent known as Pako. Then, a fateful incident after school results in a surprise confession, followed by an even more shocking attack that reveals Amelie’s true nature. But Arisa eventually becomes interested in Seiya because of his eager sincerity and his kindness in helping her through her problems. One day, however, Arisa discovers Seiya's secret that he can't tell anyone.

The equipment is so primitive that Yote needs assistance with everything from maintenance to travel!

But for Yote, it’s a chance to start over, away from his castle and his narrow-minded existence. But he must first rediscover his humanity, and only the sirens have a chance to help him with their magic... The young aristocrat offers a small fortune to Doga, a strong and resourceful orphan, to assist him in his search for these legendary creatures. She accepts his offer, and they are ready to brave all the dangers on a journey of discovery!

When he asks for Sakura, the caring bartender that Saki always talked about, the young employee who actually shows up is blunt, inconsiderate, and downright rude. Sakura's reassuring words, though blunt, affirm Yoshihiko's conflicting feelings of wanting to forget about his crush while still treasuring their time together, and end up being exactly what Yoshihiko needs to hear. And Dohu’s first impression of Seo Juheon is the complete opposite: the typical nice-guy—always smiling, always catering to the needs of those around him. But things take a turn when he accidentally comes across Juheon blackmailing someone in an alley. The real Juheon is a polar opposite from the facade he puts up; he swears, he has a temper, he’s manipulative…and Dohu loves it. Juheon could be THE inspiration for his next big novel that hit a dead end long ago. 162524.description:
When Cheong-gyeong is stranded on Mount Baekdu in the cold, he's rescued by Baek Beom, the tiger spirit that rules over the mountain. It is only right for Cheong-gyeong's memories of the supernatural to be erased and he be sent back to the human world, but Baek Beom finds himself unable to let Cheong-gyeong go. They end up spending an entire season together before Baek Beom is forced to erase Cheong-gyeong's memories and let him return to his life amongst humanity. And thus their story ends...or it may just be the beginning, right when Cheong-gyung meets a mysteriously familiar figure amidst his ordinary life.

(Source: Lezhin US)

162525.description:
Sang-Cheol who is in a lovey-dovey relationship with fellow national athlete Hwi-Gyeom- but there's one concern. Which is... Hwi-Gyeom's ** is too big... And he can't bring himself to move on to the next stage in their sex life. Despite Sang-Cheol being grateful for Hwi-Gyeom's consideration towards him, he's decided to order some adult toys to help their relationship progress further.

Why is he trying on the cute rabbit ears cosplay... But why can't the ears be taken off..?! Hwi-Gyeom finds out about Sang-Cheol's problem and decides to give him a helping hand. There's one way left that they can use to get the ears off... But what could it be?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

162527.description:

Although they are of the same gender, the two live completely different lifestyles and happened to meet by chance. In the process of getting along with each other, they both are impressed and drawn to each other's strengths. Jin Xu's bright aura allows Xiao Ran to feel the light he is unable to see. However, Jin Xu doesn't feel the same about Xiao Ran, who is talented and beautiful. Something unexpected happens...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Six chapters were released before being removed from both Bilibili and Kuaikan Manhua.

162528.description:
Zhong Xinhuai, who never believes in fate, helps his cousin teach a lesson to a scumbag who askes for a "Fated Mate" and broke up mercilessly. Only to find out he's the scumbag's real "Fated Mate"?! Since then, the cool senior has been entangled by the fate-believing "scumbag". But, he's also the new student in the same major he's a Teaching Assistant. One runs away... One chases... Can they get rid of this entanglement of fate...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

162530.description:
Ahn Jaeha, a national judo athlete, is invited as a temp instructor to Lim Seojin’s training center. Despite Seojin’s warm demeanor, Jaeha’s cold and stoic attitude creates an awkward tension between them. On his way home, Seojin unexpectedly runs into Jaeha, and in a spur-of-the-moment decision, they end up drinking together. But when Seojin wakes up from his drunken stupor, he finds Jaeha calling his name…while masturbating right in front of him!!

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

162531.description: Su, born in prison, has always wanted to see the "crow" from the story her mother told her. On the day she was going to be secretly executed, Gill, an artificial intelligence with a database of everything outside the prison, was thrown into prison for a test run. Su develops a special feeling for Gill, not caring whether her words are programmed or self-conscious, and not trying to tell if she has human emotions. Unable to distinguish her own human feelings... in this small cell, the lonely Su got her first doll--she met a "person" who could comfort her soul.

162556.description:
One day, as Haruma is making his way home from work, he saves a man, Souta, from trying to jump in front of a train. Upon discovering that Souta has no place to call home, Haruma invites Souta to stay with him for a while. While Souta is recovering from a broken heart, he finds that Haruma's kind and non-prying ways are exactly what he needed at this time in his life. Before he knows it, his heart has not only mended, but he's ready to love someone again... that someone being Haruma. Thus, the two embark on a love story that all starts by living together. (This series is written alternately by Marugari and Shiohigari.)One day, two complete strangers come together when they each make questionable decisions: Souta's of jumping in front of a moving train and Haruma's of inviting a complete stranger into his home.

After going through one bad experience after the other in school, she finally gets to marry the man of her dreams who loves her for who she is. However, he too eventually seeks out someone better-looking and cheats on her, resulting in their divorce. Oddly enough though... the woman he cheated on Aoi with is the same girl who bullied her throughout their school years...! Now Aoi's on a mission to get revenge on the man who cheated on her who is now married to the woman who made her life miserable. She has her face reshaped, her name changed to Sumire, and slowly begins to find her way into their lives...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

That man is Oscar Garland, a brave and handsome knight, admired by men and women of all ages! But to Rin, he is just "an extremely rude man whom I never want to see again." Why would she serve such a horrible man– What? If she doesn't do it, his life will be in danger?

Persuaded that it was an act of therapy, she reluctantly agreed to the job. Although it was only suppose to be for healing, Oscar's lustful reaction stirred her heart, which she thought had withered away, and before long she was absorbed in the "service," and she was aggressively attacking Oscar...

Instead of chasing the ideal societal norm, Mio takes a leap of courage to pursue the dream she has had since she was little, the "drawings" she had to hide from her mother.

His enthusiasm for games is converted into an obsession to learn and study. A super learner who is extremely eager for knowledge to become stronger is born.

"Have you heard that rumor about the man's restroom? It's haunted by the ghost of Hanako who appears there at midnight." It's the middle of the night. At his late grandfather's house, Takeru meets Kazune, a beautiful and haughty fox spirit who suddenly kisses him. Takeru has always had strong spiritual power since he was a child, and Kazune - who loves it - tells him it's like Takeru's grandfather's. Kazune hates being alone, but pretends to be tough. He's stubborn, but with every kiss, he sweetly melts and begs for another, eventually stealing Takeru's heart. The more time Takeru spends with him, the faster his beast-like desire grows, but there's a hurdle that humans and spirits must overcome if they want to live their life together...

A love story of mutual salvation, in which two lovers soothe each other's loneliness with their endless love!

3. Zetsubou no Ouhi (絶望の王妃) [Grippe]

title.native: 二次元コミックマガジン ボテ腹セックスで肉便器堕ち！
title.romaji: Nijigen Comic Magazine: Botebara Sex de Nikubenki Ochi!

162779.description: A tribute manga drawn by Naoki Urasawa to celebrate the 45th anniversary of Yasuko Aoike's Eroica yori Ai wo Komete (From Eroica with Love).

162781.description:
"We're against any attempts at Otoguro finding love!!"

The over-the-top Highschool boys' comedy begins!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Scary and Tough Otoguro, in Love?!
title.native: 俺らの乙黒さんが恋愛なんかするわけない！
title.romaji: Orera no Otoguro-san ga Renai Nanka suru Wake nai!

162782.description:
Mao Kurose can't stop thinking about Kanade Momomiya, the classmate sitting next to her. Unable to sort out her feelings, Kurose discovered memories of her past life as the Demon Lord, and recalled the moment that the Demon Lord killed the Hero. The Hero with the exact same face as Momomiya.

Here comes a girls-love story that transcends time!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 明日もまた勇者のとなり
title.romaji: Ashita mo Mata Yuusha no Tonari

162783.description:
I was kissed for the first time in my life. But it was by a guy friend!

Somiya, his usually quiet and expressionless friend, suddenly kissed him.
Hidaka, not understanding the meaning of the kiss, thought it was just for shock value.
Friends don't kiss, do they? Hidaka wondered, and Somiya replied, "Sure they do. Let's kiss once a day from now on."
He kisses him again—?!
A friend's kiss?!?!

(Source: b's-garden, translated)

162784.description:
"I'm a woman of many flaws."

(Source: The Margaret, translated)

title.native: 催眠性指導　宮島桜と宮島椿の場合
title.romaji: Saimin Seishidou: Miyajima Sakura to Miyajima Tsubaki no Baai

title.native: 悪魔の契約書に不備があるので再提出してください
title.romaji: Akuma no Keiyakusho ni Fubi ga Aru no de Saiteishutsu Shitei Kudasai

162789.description: An office lady tired of her daily life gets into a cab that takes her to an unexpected place...

162790.description:
Rinne Miki is a popular and fashionable first-year high school girl. But she has never been in a romantic relationship, even though her outgoing personality lets her make friends easily with the opposite sex. During the high school cultural festival, she meets Touma, a boy with a mysterious air… Rinne is flustered by the aggressive moves from the younger boy, but she also can't stop thinking about Touma…?

(Source: MangaCross, translated)

title.native: きみがローファーをはいたら

162791.description:
Chloe thinks she's an outcast because she does not get along with her stepmother or her fiance, Emile. One night, she goes to a masquerade ball, where she witnesses her stepsister Beatrice and her fiance Emile kissing each other! Heartbroken, she is biting back her tears when a mysterious man with a mask appears, hands her a handkerchief, and leaves. Chloe is confused, but this strange encounter is soon forgotten because she is forced to call off her engagement with Emile so that he can marry Beatrice. That is when Chloe receives a marriage proposal from a man known as "The Devil of Blysche"...!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.english: My Husband Is an Antisocial Count!
title.native: 結婚相手がコミュ障伯爵だなんて聞いてません！
title.romaji: Kekkon Aite ga Komyu Sawa Hakushakuda Nante Kiitemasen!

162792.description:
Chloe Browell, the eldest daughter of a count, is not on good terms with her step-mother, nor with her fiancé, Emile Coltrane. Then, at a masquerade ball, Chloe witnesses her step-sister Beatrice kissing Emile. As she sits on a bench and tries not to cry, a mysterious man wearing a white mask hands Chloe a handkerchief and then walks away.... A few days later, Chloe is told that her engagement has been called off, as Emile has chosen Beatrice to wed instead. Chloe is told that her new fiancé is Friedrich Blysche, the infamous "Devil of Blysche"...?

(Source: Luna Bunko, translated)

title.native: 結婚相手がコミュ障伯爵だなんて聞いてません！
title.romaji: Kekkon Aite ga Komyu Sawa Hakushakuda Nante Kiitemasen!

162793.description:
This ambitious work from 1964 was the first of its kind to incorporate the idea of "time paradox" into a shoujo manga. Borrowing the motif from the folklore of the "Yuki-Onna" (Snow Woman), it weaves an immortal love story that transcends time and space in this visionary sci-fi shoujo manga!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

162794.description:
What should I do with these expired elixirs? Don’t worry, I can revert it back in time, so give me all of your expired elixirs! What should I do if my cultivation process is too slow? Don’t worry, I'll just shift the cultivation time forwards by about five years, so it'll look like I mastered the cultivation technique right away. What if I get hurt? Don't worry, I'll just revert time back to my body's healthy state, before I got hurt. What happens if I transmigrate to a new world as a weakling? Don't worry! I can change the timeline of everything!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: I Can Change the Timeline of Everything

title.native: 我可以修改万物时间线
title.romaji: Wo Keyi Xiugai Wan Wu Shijian Xian

title.native: 僕はラブソングが歌えない
title.romaji: Boku wa Love Song ga Utaenai

162798.description:
Desire has a price—.

Makoto Shindo was raised by strict parents.
He goes to a good school, has a girlfriend, and was leading a smooth-sailing life that everyone envied.
Then one day, he committed suicide.

He should have died, but Makoto found himself reborn in another world instead.
There, he meets a witch named Isabelle.
The greedy "desire" that he had buried deep in his heart before his death is revealed....

(Source: Bebe, translated)

162799.description:
Kaede's search for a missing classmate leads to the shocking discovery that his friend is actually an alien in a human flesh suit. Grateful for Kaede’s help with her case, cute and ruthless insurance investigator Rin headhunts him. Kaede’s job interview leads to an epic battle on a commuter train, alien treachery, and a hidden spaceship. But before he can decide whether to accept the position or not, Kaede discovers another alien hidden in plain sight—one with a tragic story to share.

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Second place at the 10th Next Manga Award in the Print Manga Category in 2025.

synonyms: A Story about becoming Cooler than the Cool Girl

title.native: カッコイイ女の子よりカッコよくなろうとするお話
title.romaji: Kakkoii Onna no Ko yori Kakkoyoku Narou to Suru O-hanashi

162805.description:
When an elite corporate working woman was transferred to her company's Tokyo headquarters, her unemployed mangaka husband went along with her. Now he's the envy of all their friends, living the life of a Tokyo house-husband?

But it turns out life in Japan as a resident is very different from visiting as a tourist. The oppressive culture, the unwritten rules, and the pressures of the workplace are portrayed by the pen of Mikiman, as the Japanese imperial capital is shown in a familiar yet strange way, from the eyes of a foreign house-husband!

(Source: Creative Comic Collection, translated)

title.romaji: Zui Ran! Tokyo Ren Fu Riji

162806.description:
To educate people about the concept of "intellectual property rights" and its practical applications, we have transformed the very serious topic of intellectual property into a humorous slice-of-life manhua! Let us show you all the possibilities of working in the IP field!

(Source: Creative Comic Collection, translated)

Note: With support from the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office.

title.romaji: Yi Ren Bumen De IP Richang Shouzha

162807.description:
Pressing against tender flesh brimming with lust ♥

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic X-Eros #37

162808.description:
"The Adventure of Allen The Hero," is the novel written by our protagonist. Overwhelmingly popular and widely read, everyone was eagerly awaiting the conclusion of the story. Despite being told he doesn't have much time left to live, he put his life on the line to complete the series. Unfortunately, his lifespan ran out just as he finished writing the final volume— but…

"Why did I become such a nobody character?"
He unexpectedly transmigrated into the very novel he wrote. And he was put into the body of Will, an underdog mob character from the early part of the novel. The eldest son of a noble family soon to fall into ruin, he's a character with no talent in magic, with a miserable future ahead of him. It was the worst starting point, but that's no problem for him, the author. As the writer of the original work, he knows all when the quests and events occur, where the strongest magical items are hidden, all the characteristics and weaknesses of the monsters, and the secrets of the world itself.

In order to change his doomed fate, Will will use his knowledge of the original story and aim to become the strongest in the world. "I’ll change the future. That’s the reason why I have all this knowledge." Using his story knowledge as a cheat to change the fate of a mob character that will even have the hero in awe, he’ll gain unparalleled power in this world—!

(Source: Hyke Comic, translated)
synonyms: The Transmigrated Mage Life in Another World, Becoming the Strongest in the World With the Knowledge of the Original Story

title.native: 転生魔術師の異世界生活　原作知識で世界最強
title.romaji: Tensei Majutsushi no Isekai Seikatsu: Gensaku Chishiki de Sekai Saikyou

162809.description:
Adele Leopold has perished at the hand of the emperor three times now. As soon as her fourth life begins, she vows she won't go down the same path again. Filled with vengeance, Adele starts her new life with a plan to get back at those who wronged her. In all her lives, the one thing in common is that emperor wants her married into his family. This time, Adele will choose her husband and get the revenge she has been waiting for. But the person she decides to marry is no one anyone expected...

(Source: Tapas)

162810.description:
Fitting in with your family has never been harder.

To escape her brothel, Grizz Benedict is offered a fake identity as the Virenhague family's daughter. Her new "brother" showers her with gifts, and soon he attempts to give himself to her entirely. Despite feeling that this will all end in disaster, Grizz wonders if she ought to just accept it...

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: If You Want a Fake Sister
中にたっぷりちょうだい〜魔力チャージの仕方がアレだった!?〜

162812.description:
By the time Princess Ophelia Lidania's fourth death rolls around, she's gotten pretty sick of dying painfully. However, she seems unable to avoid her fate of being killed by her half-brother Ewout Lidania. She's tried being nice to him, locking him up, and having him killed, but it always ends the same way. So, her goal for her fifth life is to just die painlessly. To this end, she hires the elite assassin Nau to stay by her side. But will this be enough to overturn her fate and bring her peace?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.
synonyms: The Princess Wishes to Die Peacefully!
เจ้าหญิงตัวร้ายขอหายไปอย่างสงบสุข!

162813.description:
What's so great about being the daughter of a duke anyway? As the youngest child of a crazy duke with no empathy for his kids, Elena wants to live quietly and avoid her family’s bullying. But when she ends up being followed by Sirius Hyperion, the illegitimate child of the emperor and the person foretold to bring down her family, Elena decides to sit back and watch their demise. But will sticking with Sirius allow Elena to break free from her family, or will she become one of his many victims?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Will Just Stick to the Protagonist
I Will Be Next to the Main Character
ฉันจะเกาะติดอยู่ข้างกายตัวเอกเท่านั้น
I Need Someone to Stop My Older Brothers

title.native: 누가 우리 오빠들 좀 말려 주세요
title.romaji: Nuga Uri Oppadeul Jom Mallyeo Juseyo

162815.description:
1. Gakuen no Idol (学園のアイドル)
2. Hatsuiku Kensa (発育検査)
3. Ane No Kisei (姉の帰省)
4. Seito ga Goshujin-sama (生徒がご主人様)
5. Ane DVD Ver. 2.0 (姉DVD Ver. 2.0)
6. Ane DVD Ver. 4.Koma (姉DVD Ver. 4.コマ)
7. Kyoudai Tag (兄妹タッグ)
8. Katei (Shirabe) Kyoushi (家庭(調)教師)

162816.description:
For a princess, Ethela Inuas has led a pretty miserable life. Her fiancé ran off with her cousin, and her other cousin stole the throne from her, condemning her to die in the Ice Palace. However, after death, Ethela finds herself waking up several years in the past! This time around, two things are different. One, she has the ability to tell when someone is lying. Two, she's out for vengeance! Can Ethela reclaim the life she deserves and be the most dazzling princess the kingdom has ever seen?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Villainess Makes a Splendid Debut
悪女は華やかにデビューする

162817.description:
When Rosiana Evenheider opens her eyes as the villainess of the tragic novel, “The Miracle of Dawn,” she knows she has to do something if she wants to live. She must find a way to escape her evil adoptive father’s grasp while also helping the male leads one by one so that they don’t take drastic measures to claim the female lead. Will Rosiana be able to find a way to change the narrative so that everyone finds their “happily ever after”?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: For the Happy Ending of the Waste
For the Happy Ending of the Tragic Novel

title.english: To a Happy Ending for the Tragic Novel

title.native: Rusty bloom～ラスティブルーム～

162819.description:
Taeko Hano. Today is her first day of work as a receptionist for one of the biggest pharmaceutical companies in the area!

She has a bad feeling and misses the bus, which has an accident and she ends up being late... My super senses were right again, and she is determined to get back on track!

(Source: Booklive, translated)

162820.description:
Seina Rohill is a D-class hunter making a living off of killing monstrous fiends—or so she thought. In actuality, she's become an insignificant character in the novel, A Secret in the Flower Shop. What's more, she happens to be neighbors with the female lead, Ellen Euclis! The story revolves around Ellen receiving daily love confessions until she meets the male lead. But when Seina encounters a side character named Dion Fravel, who seemingly has a deep connection to Ellen, she's determined to make him Ellen's endgame. Unfortunately, Seina also has to deal with Duke Rashad Carlman, who appears to be the strongest candidate as the original male lead. As these four characters' paths cross, who truly will be the protagonists of this tale? And what could the "secret" mentioned in the novel's title be?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: อยู่ดี ๆ ก็มีนางเอกนิยายเป็นเพื่อนบ้าน

title.english: The Runaway Lead Lives Next Door

162821.description:
40 pages in the secret garden of forbidden psalms!

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic X-Eros #43

162822.description:
After Touya and Haru’s son, Ao, was released from the hospital, the Togawa family was ready for a fresh start in their picturesque new home. But the life Touya envisioned for his family is turned upside down when mysterious postcards begin to appear. No sender, no return address—just a note describing an event that will happen in the future! Following the prophetic cards, Touya embarks on an adventure to help those in need, keep his family safe, and unravel the mystery before disaster catches up with them…

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: ザサーティーンスフットプリント

162823.description:
Drown yourself in the garden of lust...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic X-Eros #45

162824.description:
To resurrect her dead mother, Lulutier is abused in a magic experiment by her father, which shortens her lifespan significantly. Now deemed useless, she's forced to marry an old count. Refusing to accept her fate, Lulutier kisses the priest officiating the wedding to call the marriage off. Much to her surprise, said priest turns out to be Captain Caintzel of the Holy Order, who offers to become her husband instead! But can this holy knight offer Lulutier the sanctuary she truly needs?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Obsessive Second Male Lead Has Gone Wild

162826.description:
The main character, stressed out from dieting and studying and decided to read the fantasy novel I Want to Be Ugly for Just One Day. She thought she would live a happy life as the daughter of a countess in the book, but the story turned out to be incredibly tedious... Our protagonist will try her best to change the original to make herself the happiest in the world, to protect her beloved family... Chubby will change history!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Chubby Female Lead Is Popular

162827.description:
On the day of her retirement, history professor Jung Gwinam is hit by a bus as she pushes her daughter out of the way. When she wakes up, she finds herself in a different world, a different time, and even a different body! Now living as Delia, the protagonist of her daughter's novel, she'll have to climb the social ladder to escape life as a peasant. Despite some historical inaccuracies in this fantasy world, will Delia’s extensive knowledge be enough to help her make it back to the real world?

(Source: Tapas)

162828.description:
Dan-Young, the only doctor of the San-Woon Dang, is tasked to treat Baek-Gyeom, the weapon of the Spirits who might be her father's enemy. But the herb used for his treatment has the side effect of stimulating his lust!

"Whatever I do, it's difficult to lower my constantly rising temperature."

"...and so?"

"Hold me."

"Pardon?"

Baek-Gyeom's eyes rolled as his speech slurred, not hiding his absurdity. He cast a shadow when he hovered his body over Dan-Young's. His long arms snaked around her waist. A weary smile appeared on Baek-Gyeom's lips when Dan-Young's breath hitched as she grabbed his arm.

"You cannot refuse me, of course."

(Source: Naver, translated)

162829.description:
Heeran Kang had one goal: vengeance. She was murdered in her first life and is abused in the next by her stepmother, but meeting her gentle nanny puts Heeran's revenge on hold...until her stepmother murders her nanny. Guided by insight from her first life, she makes alliances and moves to the Prison of Abyss. There, she is shown unexpected kindness. Will she fulfill her vengeance, or can she honor her nanny another way, and live a good life?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: I Want to Live a Good Life

162830.description:
During a party, Cecil, a low-ranked white mage, sprays a homemade potion into the face of Oswald, the handsome captain of the First Paladin Squadron and the most eligible bachelor in high society. She only did it because she could sense a strong taint of evil emanating from him, but an angry Oswald forcibly takes Cecil back to his mansion. She thought that her chastity might be in jeopardy, but he brushes her off, saying, "You're not my type." It turns out Oswald's true purpose is to learn more about Cecil's potion, which is the only medicine that has been effective against a cursed wound he received in battle. When Oswald formally requests Cecil's help, she decides to take advantage of this chance to make her mark as a white mage!

A romantic comedy between a cursed holy knight and a clumsy white mage is about to begin!

(Source: Comic Zero-Sum, translated)

title.native: 落ちこぼれ白魔導士セシルは対象外のはずでした
title.romaji: Ochikobore Shiro Madoushi Cecil wa Taishougai no Hazu deshita

162832.description:
1. Ane DVD-R (姉DVD-R)
2. Nure Shoujo (濡れ少女)
3. Mangaka (マン画家)
4. Kousoku (拘束)
5. Kousoku Shitsu (拘束室)
6. Ani no Tehodoki (兄の手ほどき)
7. Tokutaisei (特待生)
8. Tokutaisei to Sensei (特待生と先生)
9. Houkei Ijiri (ホーケイいじり)

162834.description:
Cecil, a low-ranked white mage, doused Oswald, captain of the First Paladins and a popular man with the ladies, with a homemade potion at a party at the royal castle. He was emitting a strong evil aura! The angry Oswald forcibly took Cecil back to his mansion, and she was worried about his intentions. However, he brushes her off, saying, "You're not my type," and asks her to treat him instead, saying that Cecil's potion was the first to work on his cursed wound. Cecil takes it as a chance to make her mark as a healer, but......? A love comedy between a holy paladin and a failed white mage!

(Source: Melissa, translated)

title.native: 落ちこぼれ白魔導士セシルは対象外のはずでした
title.romaji: Ochikobore Shiro Madoushi Cecil wa Taishougai no Hazu deshita

162835.description:
In the distant future, there will be species from different realms that walk this earth and coexist with humans. And of course, not everyone and everything will be peaceful. To combat any conflicts that arise, a new Special Task Force is founded: Soul Justice. The Soul Justice is so strong that they even defeated the Demon King and stopped his quest for world domination. (Don't worry, he has since turned a new leaf as a highly-skilled farmer.) Mamoru Akamichi is Soul Red of the Soul Justice. And although he helped save the world from the Demon King, he remains as upbeat and humble as ever. He protects everybody, even the Demon King's clumsy son, Lulud, who has proclaimed himself to be Soul Red's arch-nemesis. To Akamichi, defeating Lulud is simple as pie, much to the Demon Prince's dismay. Challenge after challenge, duel after duel, Akamichi always comes out the victor. What can Lulud do to conquer his archenemy finally?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: Tell Us How You Really Feel, Demon Prince!
title.native: 魔王の息子は素直になれないっ！
title.romaji: Maou no Musuko wa Sunao ni Narenai!

162836.description:
Fuyuya Tadokoro, a college student who just started living alone in spring, has a suspicious neighbor...! When Fuyuya peeks over the balcony, he finds a beautiful girl naked and panting! The girl dragged Fuyuya into the room and pulled him right on top of her. And in the room, there are lights and filming equipment... Yes... she is a Sexy Liver, her job is live-streaming adult video.

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

162837.description:
Deep in the mountains in western Tokyo, there sits the hidden Gekka girls' high school. All the students attending are actually...ninjas!

Kasane Hattori and Saika Kirigakure are two of the very ninja girls enrolled to Gekka. Kasane sees Saika as a rival to surpass, and is working every day to improve her ninja arts. But first, she'll have to finish her homework...in seduction?!

It's school rules to train your seduction skills with the girl you're rooming with, but how is Kasane supposed to practice when her roommate is none-other than Saika Kirigakure?!

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

title.native: 妹の身代わりで嫁いだはずが、どうやら私が真の聖女だったようです～自由気ままなスローライフを満喫しているのでほっといてください！～
title.romaji: Imouto no Migawari de Totsui da Hazu ga, Douyara Watashi ga Shinno Seijou datta You desu: Juuki Mama na Slow Life wo Mankitsushiteiru no de Hottoite Kudasai!

title.native: 妹の身代わりで嫁いだはずが、どうやら私が真の聖女だったようです～自由気ままなスローライフを満喫しているのでほっといてください！～
title.romaji: Imouto no Migawari de Totsui da Hazu ga, Douyara Watashi ga Shinno Seijou datta You desu: Juuki Mama na Slow Life wo Mankitsushiteiru no de Hottoite Kudasai!

162841.description:
Sagino Seiichi, a con artist, is tasked with stopping Koi Karasuma, a police officer with a keen sense for crime. When Sagino tries to approach her, she tells him right away that he "smelled like a criminal." In desperation, Sagino tries to placate Karasuma with flattery. One thing leads to another, and the mission starts heading in an unexpected direction…?

(Source: Comic Polca, translated)

title.native: 詐欺師と警察官の恋愛距離
title.romaji: Sagishi to Keisatsukan no Renai Kyori

162843.description:
What is time......? What is life......? The superhuman Miraiser Ban travels through time, between the past and the future! In the eternal wheel of time, a boy will fight for his destiny...!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

162844.description:
For one reason or another, our heroine, the anonymous "Jane Doe" witch, decides to buy herself two twin dragon boys as slaves.

Several years passed , and the twins have grown up. Even though they're supposed to be slaves, they feel more like family, and they even think of the witch as such. But she's hiding something, and they want to know exactly what.

"We're family, right? There's nothing to hide."

Even then, she wouldn't tell them.

They couldn't take it anymore, and so they created a plan...

(Source: DLsite)
synonyms: dog eat dog era: Hypnotic Mating With Twin Dragonkin Slaves

title.native: dog eat dog era～竜人族奴隷の双子と催眠交尾~
title.romaji: dog eat dog era: Ryuujinzoku Dorei no Futago to Saimin Koubi

162845.description:
"When you two return, let me have a proper talk with you."

The Jane Doe Witch finally decides to tell the twins why she bought them as slaves. But while the twins were away at school, a visitor came.

"I've been looking for you."

The man in front of her was the mage knight she was betrothed to, the one she foresaw would eventually take her life.
The witch had been on the lookout, but she had let her guard down when the twins went away to school.......

"I don't mind you taking on those petulant-looking slaves, but...
Is there any reason you won't accept me?"

The mage knight tries to get the truth out of the witch by using hypnotic magic.
When the twins notice something is wrong and return home, they find...

(Source: DLSite, translated)

title.native: dog eat dog era～許婚の魔法騎士と催眠尋問～
title.romaji: dog eat dog era: Kyokon no Mahou Kishi to Saimin Jimmon

162846.description:
Her boss pinned her down in the company's nap room and told her, "The truth is, is that you want to sleep with me right?" while his lips drew nearer to hers…

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Life of an Adult Video Script Writer
title.native: AV脚本家なら、これぐらい…普通だろ？
title.romaji: AV Kyakuhonka Nara, Kore Gurai… Futsuu Daro?

162849.description:
Dong-Hyuk has one go-to hobby: lusting after the beautiful actress Hwa Riae. Others might call it a mid-life crisis since he’s almost 50 now, but who cares? He still thinks she’s the hottest person to ever walk the face of the earth. But he sure wasn’t expecting to meet her in real life… and definitely not as his son’s girlfriend, or just maybe, his future daughter-in-law? Dong-Hyuk tries hard to deny his feelings, but Riae’s even sexier in person. And going by how she looks at him, looks like those sparks aren’t one-sided, either…

(Source: Lezhin X)

162972.description:
In Kimi to Aoi Yoru no readers themselves take on the role of the characters in the story and play out the story using a companion site. The story begins three weeks after the mysterious disappearance of Rino Tsunamoto, a high school girl, when four classmates secretly gather at school at night to try to solve the case. Readers take on the role of these four high school students as they try to get to the bottom of the "Rino Disappearance Case."

(Source: Natalie, translated)

162973.description:
"Show me how you make babies."

Nina is a mermaid who has longed for the world on land. She took drugs to grow legs so she could interact with humans and learn how they live, but no one has taught her anything about sex. What is it about sex that humans find so fascinating? Nina desperately wants to find out, so she asks a handsome male-host who had found her while camping in the forest. Two people from different worlds gradually become attracted to each other in this melancholic fantasy love story.

(Source: Bebe, translated)

title.native: 欲しがり人魚拾いました。

162974.description: At first, Takayuki Narumi is befriended by Mitsuki Hayase only because Mitsuki's best friend, Haruka Suzumiya has a crush on him; however since then, Takayuki, his pal Shinji Taira, and Mitsuki have grown to be the best of friends. Then one day, Haruka confesses to Takayuki her love for him. Not wanting to hurt her feelings, Takayuki agrees to go out with her. After a few incidents, their relationship gets intimate, even while Takayuki and Mitsuki begin to realize their feelings for each other. But suddenly, when tragedy strikes, things are never the same for these four friends again.

162975.description:
Flat broke, a young man is renting an apartment with a “shady history.” Nothing's actually happened there—it just feels like something might be looming. You know, ghosts, goblins, curses, no big deal... Until one day, a ghost really did show up and knocked the wind (a very audible fart) out of him. That's how his unexpected cohabitation with the ghost girl, “Yuko” begins. What started out as bizarre gradually became ordinary—and those ordinary days become irreplaceable. A heartwarming story born in a haunted apartment.

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.english: Yuko, the Ghost in My Room
title.native: 僕の部屋のユウ子さん

162976.description:
God gives each person one special skill in life, to help them fight monsters.

Chrome, who longs to be an adventurer but never manifested any special fighting skill, refuses to give up on his dream. So he works as a low-ranked adventurer doing miscellaneous work while being scorned as useless by others. One day, he is left behind as bait in order to let the others escape from the monsters, and loses his life in the process. That is when Chrome's special skill is activated.

The skill is "Revive."

With this skill, which allows him to come back to life only once, he miraculously survives - as a skeletal monster named "Wight." Chrome despairs at his monstrous appearance, but then he remembers the story of how monsters evolve and change their forms as they become stronger. Believing that he could regain his human form through repeated evolution, he continues to hunt monsters. And in the process, he acquires multiple skills that are only available to non-humans.

The power of monsters, combined with human intelligence. Turning adversity into opportunity, Chrome sets out to become the strongest adventurer ever.

(Source: Hyke Comic, translated)

162977.description: In the modern world, Xu Fei is an ordinary three-no college student: no looks, no money, and no future. But in the other-world, he is a martial artist, a cultivator, and a magician. The other-world martial arts skills make him unbeatable in the modern world, but it's not like an overwhelming super-power. The other-world resembles ancient times, where medicine, economics, and political systems are still primitive. Being able to travel between the two worlds, Xu Fei will use his unique skills to pick up women and become a tycoon in each world!

Hiroki Okami works at a drugstore, and Shintaro Takimoto is a young man who visits the store at the same time every day. Their short talks was a secret pleasure for Hiroki at work. One day, Shintaro confides in Hiroki, “I don’t have the courage to confess to the person I like.” In turn, Hiroki encourages him, “It’ll be fine, you're so attractive.” That was when Shintaro suddenly confesses, “The one I like is Okami-san!?"
